Job Summary

PT Agrinusa Jaya Santosa (Japfa Group) is looking for a detail-oriented and proactive individual to join our team as Procurement Staff Non-COGS. This position is responsible for managing procurement activities related to non-production goods and services required to support the company's daily operations, including office supplies, IT equipment, operational equipment, facility maintenance, and other administrative needs. The role focuses on identifying reliable suppliers, negotiating competitive prices, ensuring timely delivery, and maintaining effective procurement processes to support operational efficiency and cost optimization.

Job Responsibilities

• Process purchase requisitions for non-production goods and services, including office supplies, IT equipment, operational equipment, facility maintenance, marketing materials, and other general administrative needs.
• Source, evaluate, and select vendors or suppliers based on quality, price, service, and reliability.
• Conduct price negotiations with vendors regarding pricing, payment terms, delivery schedules, and other procurement requirements.
• Prepare, issue, and monitor Purchase Orders (PO) in accordance with company procedures and procurement policies.
• Monitor and follow up on order and delivery status to ensure goods and services are delivered on time and meet the required specifications.
• Coordinate with internal departments to identify procurement requirements and resolve issues related to purchasing, delivery, or supplier performance.
• Maintain accurate procurement records, vendor databases, price comparison documents, and other supporting documentation for reporting and audit purposes.
• Monitor procurement expenses and identify opportunities for cost efficiency without compromising quality and operational requirements.

Job Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree (S1) in Business Administration, Management, Finance, Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
• Minimum 1–2 years of experience in Procurement or Purchasing, preferably handling Non-COGS or indirect procurement.
• Experience in purchasing office supplies, IT equipment, operational equipment, facility maintenance, or other non-production goods and services is preferred.
• Strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office, particularly Microsoft Excel, and familiar with ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
• Detail-oriented, analytical, responsible, and possessing a high level of integrity.
• Able to work independently and collaboratively in a dynamic work environment.
• Willing to be placed in Kedoya, West Jakarta.

wo-klbf-JR26_000997.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Operate production machinery and equipment, ensuring adherence to schedules and standards.
- Perform regular maintenance and repairs on equipment to ensure optimal performance.
- Identify and resolve production issues to minimize downtime.
- Ensure adherence to production schedules and standards, maintaining high levels of quality.
- Maintain a clean and safe work environment, following all safety protocols and regulations.
- Assist in the implementation of production improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce costs.
- Coordinate with other team members to ensure smooth production processes.

- Mengoperasikan mesin dan peralatan produksi, memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar.
- Melakukan pemeliharaan dan perbaikan rutin pada peralatan untuk memastikan kinerja optimal.
- Mengidentifikasi dan memecahkan masalah produksi untuk meminimalkan waktu henti.
- Memastikan kepatuhan terhadap jadwal dan standar produksi, menjaga tingkat kualitas yang tinggi.
- Memelihara lingkungan kerja yang bersih dan aman, mengikuti semua protokol dan regulasi keselamatan.
- Mendukung implementasi perbaikan produksi untuk meningkatkan efisiensi dan mengurangi biaya.
- Berkoordinasi dengan anggota tim lain untuk memastikan proses produksi yang lancar.

Company:
DF PT. Dankos Farma
